project_type: Next.js 14 App Router monorepo (pnpm workspaces). Web app at apps/web, shared packages under packages/
build_system: pnpm workspaces. Web app build: `cd apps/web && npm run build` (runs `prisma generate && next build`). Type-check only: `npm run type-check` (tsc --noEmit). No test framework present in apps/web.
test_framework: None in apps/web. Type-check via `npm run type-check`. Lint via `npm run lint`.
verification_instructions: 1. Run `npm run type-check` in apps/web — must exit 0. 2. Run `npm run lint` in apps/web — must exit 0. 3. If build env available: `npm run build`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/database/src/generated/client — regenerated by `prisma generate`. Already present. No new migrations needed for this task.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Worktree root is d:\Discord Projects\Tournament-Bot\esports-platform. DO NOT use relative paths — always use absolute paths from that root.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: server components fetch data with Prisma and serialize dates to ISO strings before passing to client components. Client components use 'use client' directive. Auth via createClient() from @/lib/supabase/server, role check via resolveUserRole from @esports/permissions.
key_patterns: 1. Page files: async server components, auth + role check at top, Prisma fetch, serialize dates, pass to client component. 2. Client components: 'use client', GlassCard + GlowButton + Badge from @/components/ui/. 3. API routes: withPermission(AppRole.TOURNAMENT_MANAGER, handler) wrapper. 4. Toast via sonner. 5. Tabs via @radix-ui/react-tabs. 6. Table columns via @tanstack/react-table. 7. Registration actions: PATCH /api/servers/[guildId]/registrations/[registrationId] with {action: 'approve'|'reject'|'request_correction', reason?}. 8. Publish: POST /api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/publish. 9. Cancel: POST /api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/cancel with {reason}. 10. Finalize: POST /api/servers/[guildId]/tournaments/[tournamentId]/finalize. 11. Admin tournament detail GET: /api/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId] (returns {tournament} with stages, registrations). 12. Admin tournament PATCH: /api/servers/[guildId]/admin/tournaments/[tournamentId] (all editable fields).
directory_structure: apps/web/src/app/ — Next.js pages and API routes. apps/web/src/components/admin/ — admin panel client components. apps/web/src/components/ui/ — shared UI primitives (GlassCard, GlowButton, Badge, Skeleton). packages/database/ — Prisma client and schema. packages/permissions/ — withPermission HOC and AppRole enum.
